SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. .........
SECTION 2 Station,
REPORT
Date October 26, 1933

Subject (in full) Mrs E.A. Manjosova alias Mrs D. Manjosova.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached memo of the Officer
i/c Special Branch dated October 11, 1933 on the subject of
Mrs D. Manjosova residing at No 22-C Route Pere Robert, discreet
enquiries regarding the antecedents and character of this indi-
vidual reveal the following information:-
Mrs Eudoxia A. Manjosova alias Mrs D. Manjosova, Rus-
sian, born March 1, 1892, at Blagoveschensk, Amur province, Siberia.
She arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on March 12, 1929, together
with her daughter, Miss O.P. Manjosova. When registering with the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, No 6-A Hongkong Road, she stated
that she had resided in Harbin since 1921, and that she was a
masseuse by occupation.
Places where she has resided in Shanghai include
No 602 Avenue Joffre, 687 Avenue Joffre, 76 Route des Soeurs,
No 350 Avenue Joffre, Apt 95, No 102 Rue Marcel Tillot and No 22-C
Route Pere Robert.
It was in connection with her occupation that Mrs Man-
josova came to the notice of the Municipal Police during the
summer of 1930. An extract from the police report dated June 28,
1930, on the subject of massage establishments reads as follows:-
" No 76 Route des Soeurs is occupied by Mrs Manjosloff,
aged 37, Russian. She conducts a massage business there and her
hours of business are from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. Inquiries show
that she is not a masseuse and conducts this affair in order to
attain acquaintances with men for immoral purposes" ( File
D.1345 ).

第2分区警署，

日期 1933年10月26日

事由（全称） E.A. 曼乔索娃夫人（又名 D. 曼乔索娃夫人）。

制作人 D.S. 普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人 [签名]

兹参照特别分部主管警官于1933年10月11日就居住在罗伯特神父路22-C号的D. 曼乔索娃夫人一事所附备忘录，经对该人的背景及品行进行秘密查访，获悉如下信息：
尤多克西娅·A. 曼乔索娃夫人（又名 D. 曼乔索娃夫人），俄罗斯人，1892年3月1日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔省布拉戈维申斯克。她于1929年3月12日与其女儿 O.P. 曼乔索娃小姐一同从哈尔滨抵达上海。在向香港路6-A号俄罗斯侨民委员会登记时，她声称自1921年起便居住在哈尔滨，职业为按摩师。
她在上海居住过的地址包括：霞飞路602号、霞飞路687号、修女路76号、霞飞路350号、马塞尔·蒂洛路102号95室以及罗伯特神父路22-C号。
曼乔索娃夫人因其职业关系，于1930年夏季引起工部局警务处的注意。摘自1930年6月28日关于按摩场所的警务报告内容如下：
“修女路76号由37岁的俄罗斯人曼乔斯洛夫夫人占用。她在此经营按摩业务，营业时间为上午10时至晚上9时。经查，她并非按摩师，经营此事旨在结识男性以图不轨目的”（档案 D.1345）。
据报，在1930年或1931年的某个时候，一名葡萄牙人向法国巡捕房投诉称，当其与曼乔索娃夫人在一起时，其某些财物被盗。警方认为该投诉毫无根据，但据当事警官回忆，此事的细节表明曼乔索娃夫人当时的生活作风不检点。

pany with Mrs Manjosova. The police considered the complaint as
being unfounded, but the details of the affair as far as the po-
lice officer concerned can remember, were such as would suggest
disorderly character of Mrs Manjosova's life at that time.
Enquiries show that since 1931 Mrs Manjosova, who is
a widow, cohabited with one G.P. Virth, Russian, jeweller and op-
tician by occupation, who conducted his own business at No 51
Nanking Road and whose wife and children resided in Harbin.
She lived with him until March 31, 1933 when he died suddenly.
Mr. Virth's business, it is reported, was almost a complete fai-
lure about the time of his death and the rumour has it that
Mrs Manjosova was to a certain extent responsible for his finan-
cial ruin.
In June 1933 she went to reside at No ??-C Route
Pere Robert at which address she conducts a boarding-house.

查访显示，自1931年以来，曼乔索娃夫人（寡妇）与一名俄罗斯人 G.P. 维斯同居。维斯的职业为珠宝商和配镜师，在南京路51号自营生意，其妻儿居住在哈尔滨。
她与他共同生活至1933年3月31日，当日维斯突然去世。据报，维斯的生意在其去世前后几乎彻底失败，且有谣言称曼乔索娃夫人对其财务破产负有一定责任。
1933年6月，她搬至罗伯特神父路??-C号居住，并在该地址经营一家寄宿公寓。
G. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别分部主管警官。
